newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Pemex crude, natgas output up in May.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Pemex crude, natgas output up in May.

text.p: Mexico's state owned oil and gas monopoly Petroleos Mexicanos (Pemex) said on Wednesday that its average crude output for May was 2.989 million barrels per day (bpd) compared to 2.874 million bpd in May of last year.
Pemex said average natural gas production was 4.422 billion cubic feet per day (cfd) in May, compared with 4.328 cfd for the same month a year earlier.
Pemex said average April natural gas exports were 77.6 million cfd compared to 122.7 million cfd in May 1996..
Natural gas imports were an average 53.6 million cfd for the month, compared to 60.7 million cfd a year ago.
